# HIJAZI Apartments

> HIJAZI Apartments (شقق حجازي المفروشة) rents fully furnished apartments in Shmeisani, Amman, Jordan, next to Abdali. Every apartment has 3 bedrooms (one master), 3 bathrooms, a kitchen and Wi-Fi; most have two balconies. Stays can be daily, weekly or monthly, with a special discount for stays longer than one month. The location is close to Jordan Hospital and the Specialty Hospital in Shmeisani, and to the Islamic Hospital and Abdali Hospital in Abdali, so guests include families, patients and their companions, and business travellers.

- Location: Shmeisani, Amman, Jordan (next to Abdali)
- Phone / WhatsApp: +962 78 900 0444
- Email: info@hijazi-apartments.com
- Booking: https://www.hijazi-apartments.com/apartments.html
- Languages: Arabic and English
